data.one_liner: Convenience package exporting all optional flutter_html widgets.
data.what_it_does: It bundles and re-exports flutter_html extensions such as audio, iframe, math, svg, table, and video, allowing developers to enable all optional renders with a single import.
use_when: You need all optional flutter_html renders in one place
You want to avoid multiple dependency imports
avoid_when: You only need a subset of the extensions
You are concerned about bundle size
weaknesses: Adds unnecessary dependencies if only a few extensions are used
